sources.snippet: If Kuza helps you code on the go, consider starring ⭐ the repo — it helps other Android developers find this project! Kuza is a modular, local AI assistant focused on automation, coding, research, and autonomous task execution. Built to be fast, extensible, and transparent, it learns from experience while remaining reliable and truthful.
